d: Short-length, layered honey-blonde hair with choppy bangs and a side-swept fringe. Narrow, light-brown eyes with a gentle expression on a youthful, teenage face. A slender build wearing a red and white military-style jacket with gold buttons, a black pleated mini-skirt, black thigh-high stockings, and red ankle boots. Accessories include a red peaked cap with a gold emblem and a brown clipboard held in one hand.
